en-US.description: An Open-Source Program for Data Visualization and Analysis with Chemical Intelligence
en-US.longDescription: DataWarrior is an open-source program for data visualization and analysis with chemical intelligence. DataWarrior combines dynamic graphical views and interactive row filtering with chemical intelligence. Scatter plots, box plots, bar charts and pie charts not only visualize numerical or category data, but also show trends of multiple scaffolds or compound substitution patterns. Chemical descriptors encode various aspects of chemical structures, e.g. the chemical graph, chemical functionality from a synthetic chemist’s point of view or 3-dimensional pharmacophore features. These allow for fundamentally different types of molecular similarity measures, which can be applied for many purposes including row filtering and the customization of graphical views. DataWarrior supports the enumeration of combinatorial libraries as the creation of evolutionary libraries. Compounds can be clustered and diverse subsets can be picked. Calculated compound similarities can be used for multidimensional scaling methods, e.g. Kohonen nets. Physicochemical properties can be calculated, structure activity relationship tables can be created and activity cliffs be visualized.
en-US.name: DataWarrior

zh-CN.description: 开源化学智能数据可视化和分析程序
zh-CN.longDescription: DataWarrior 是一款集化学智能于一身的数据可视化与分析开源软件。DataWarrior 将动态图形视图、交互式行筛选与化学智能深度融合。其散点图、箱线图、条形图及饼图不仅能展示数值或分类数据，更能呈现多骨架化合物趋势及分子取代模式。化学描述符可编码分子结构的多维特征：包括化学拓扑图、合成化学视角的功能团分布，以及三维药效团特征。这些特性支持构建本质差异化的分子相似性度量方法，适用于行筛选、图形视图定制等多种场景。DataWarrior 支持组合化合物库的枚举及进化式化合物库构建，可实现分子聚类与多样性子集筛选。计算所得的化合物相似度可用于多维标度分析（如 Kohonen 网络）。软件还能计算理化性质、构建构效关系表，并可视化活性悬崖现象。
